params.1273: Put a rake, dibber and spade in your tool belt so you can plant crops.
params.1274: <col=FFFFFF>Right-click</col> <col=FFFFFF>Head Farmer Jones</col> and select <col=FFFFFF>trade</col>. Get a free <col=FFFFFF>rake</col>, <col=FFFFFF>seed dibber</col> and <col=FFFFFF>spade</col>.
params.1275: Add all the tools to your tool belt by <col=FFFFFF>right-clicking</col> each tool in your inventory and selecting <col=FFFFFF>Add-to-toolbelt</col>.
